source: Coordinator's brief for 8.0.0-beta.6, 2026-11-21 (the properties review, items 22, 23 and 26; memory by heap share); RFC 0006 §9.3
statement: A BEST_EFFORT decision listener's queue holds its part of the decision listeners' share of the heap (`STA-12`), divided equally by the BEST_EFFORT listeners and counted in events at the measured size of an event of the pipeline's trace level (`HeapBudget.decisionEventBytes`: untraced, and traced at `full` and `exhaustive`, whose trace carries every candidate statement; each held by a test never below what such an event retains on a representative deployment's documents and at most twice it, the traced ones at their upper case, a denied request). A traced pipeline's queues hold fewer events, never the untraced count of traced events. The count is reckoned once, when the listeners are built: nothing is measured on the request path. A full queue drops the next event and counts it (`cosec.listener.dropped`).
guards: runtime:DecisionEventSizeTest#the constant a queue counts with is what a decision event retains at its trace level, within a factor of two
runtime:PipelineBuilderTest#a built pipeline's listener queues are one BEST_EFFORT listener's part of the heap share
spring-boot:SnapshotReadinessTest#listener queues are a share of the heap, and the drain a sixth of the shutdown phase
spring-boot:SnapshotReadinessTest#a traced pipeline's listener queues count events at their traced size
